answer: A household proves real water use by publishing monthly meter readings signed by the utility's key, each reading chained to the last with the meter serial and a photo hash of the dial. A verifier checks the signature, the monotonic increase, and that consumption sits in a plausible band for household size. A vault of past readings makes sudden jumps auditable, so a desert oasis community can trust shared rationing without trusting any single claimant, and a walnut farmer's irrigation draw is metered the same way.
